title: Appropriateness is all you need! General-purpose chatbots and what they may and may not say
reasoning: The paper focuses on the concept of 'moral appropriateness' for chatbots as a normative requirement. It evaluates the ethical duties of AI agents, discusses religious content (e.g., the 'Jewish President' example), and proposes using challenge sets and the MACHIAVELLI benchmark to validate these ethical/moral dimensions.
